interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Repair and widen the existing sidewalk on the left to meet ADA standards and provide a clear path around utility poles.

interventions.title: Shared Street Treatment
interventions.description: Given the narrow width, convert the street into a 'shared street' or 'woonerf' with level surfaces and traffic calming to prioritize pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically directed at the walkway to improve visibility and safety at night.

interventions.title: Relocate Signage
interventions.description: Move the signpost to the edge of the sidewalk or a dedicated furniture zone to maintain a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and personal security for pedestrians after dark.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clear Path Improvement
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk or relocate the utility pole to provide a continuous, unobstructed walking width of at least 5 feet.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the concrete sidewalk to remove cracks and weeds, ensuring a smooth, accessible path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a raised, paved sidewalk on at least one side of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or a shared-street design with textured paving to slow vehicle speeds and prioritize pedestrian safety in the shared space.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Intersections
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the ends of the block to improve sightlines for pedestrians entering the roadway from between parked cars.

interventions.title: Raised Alley Crossing
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk across the alley entrance at a level grade to slow vehicles and clearly signal pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 5-6 feet to improve accessibility and comfort.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Implement policies or community programs to ensure sidewalks remain clear of bins and debris to maintain a continuous path of travel.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repave the street to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces, improving safety for all users.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and level the roadway surface to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures and clear signage to formalize the space as a shared zone where pedestrians have priority over vehicles.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Clear weeds and encroaching vegetation to restore the usable width of the existing walkway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the end of the block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility around parked cars.

interventions.title: Vegetation Maintenance
interventions.description: Trim or remove overgrown bushes that obstruct the public right-of-way to restore the full width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near driveways and potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Adding a vegetated buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical separation from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Installing vertical deflection to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Management
interventions.description: Establish designated areas for trash collection that do not impede the pedestrian clear zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furnishings Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a safety buffer and improve the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Designated Waste Storage
interventions.description: Providing designated areas for trash and recycling bins to ensure the clear walking width of the sidewalk is maintained.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Clear overgrown vegetation and debris from the walkway to ensure the full width is accessible.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Clearing
interventions.description: Repair cracked pavement and establish clear zones for trash collection to keep the walkway unobstructed.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Pave and widen the sidewalks on both sides to meet standard accessibility requirements and provide a continuous walking path.

interventions.title: Parking Management and Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or enforce parking rules to prevent cars from parking on the sidewalk area, ensuring the walkway remains clear.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Management
interventions.description: Implement regular trash collection and enforcement to keep the pedestrian walkway clear of debris and obstructions.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Green Infrastructure
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters to provide a vertical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, improving the pedestrian environment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance and Waste Management
interventions.description: Implement regular street cleaning and enforce rules regarding the placement of trash and recycling bins to ensure the sidewalk remains clear for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate utility poles to the edge of the sidewalk or a dedicated furniture zone to maximize the clear path for pedestrians, especially those with mobility aids.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide safe separation.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at the approaching intersection to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to remove cracks and weeds, ensuring a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearing and Maintenance
interventions.description: Implement and enforce trash management policies to ensure the narrow walkways remain free of bins and bags.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a raised sidewalk with a curb to clearly define and protect the pedestrian zone from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety for residents at night.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the corner.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Leveling
interventions.description: Repair the cracked sidewalk surface to ensure a smooth, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening or Pole Relocation
